scope: Aggregate export of completed EVIDA development comparisons E2 and E4. No experiments were rerun for this export.

e2_semantic_literature_retrieval.population_note: Primary recall averages the 188 queries with evidence gold. The 300 encoded queries and the separate citation-retrieval population are not this denominator.
e2_semantic_literature_retrieval.metric_definition: For each query, retrieved relevant documents among the first 10 divided by its relevant-document count; arithmetic mean over the 188 eligible queries.

difference_95_interval.method: 46 frozen source-connected batches, paired percentile bootstrap
difference_95_interval.status: Copied from the completed frozen evaluation; bootstrap not rerun for export.

equal_conditions: Gold labels withheld during retrieval inference.
No parameter or threshold tuning in this saved comparison.
e2_semantic_literature_retrieval.adoption: Optional semantic relevance ordering for retained literature titles and abstracts, with exact source navigation and content-hash incremental indexing. Existing source browsing is preserved.
limits: Public development benchmark; possible exposure through original model training data.
Retriever component comparison, not a reproduction of the complete author system.
Retrieval relevance is separate from answer accuracy, biological evidence strength and efficacy.

e4_activity_input_meaning.comparison: Original mixed-endpoint/stripped-bound processing versus repaired endpoint- and relation-preserving input processing.
input_semantics: Retain original relation and unit; for nM values pActivity = 9 - log10(value_nM), with inequality direction reversed.
Select one endpoint by exact-structure coverage before fitting; use exact values for point regression and preserve bounds outside point fitting.
Retain source-specific assay, species and action conditions; a common endpoint name alone does not establish assay equivalence.
e4_activity_input_meaning.fixed_evaluation: Original Murcko scaffold assignment frozen before both fits; both arms scored on identical exact IC50 values for common evaluation compounds.
e4_activity_input_meaning.adoption: Use the repaired measurement semantics in the operational input path. Predictions are conditional on the model evaluation and applicability checks; original historical outputs are preserved.
limits: Stored development cases, not a new independent target or source validation.
Training set size changes between the two arms; individual repair effects are not isolated.
No uncertainty interval or statistical-significance claim is supplied for these activity metrics.
The comparison evaluates data processing and prediction; it supplies no new molecular activity, selectivity or clinical efficacy measurements.

export_verification.published_payload: Aggregate metrics, conditions, hashes and public references only.
